messages:
fiona: Release cut blocked by deploy-bot. Validation failed: manifest digest mismatch for redwood/inference:canary-20260324. Looks like two different manifests reference different layer sets.

ci-cache: CI publish logs (job 8021): push manifest sha256:111aaa at 10:05:12Z. Later cache dedupe job touched layer index and cache-migration wrote a new manifest sha256:222bbb at 10:05:45Z. Both were created by the same pipeline run due to concurrent cache compaction.

deploy-bot: system: promotion halted - manifest-layerset-conflict detected for tag 'canary-20260324'. Lock acquired. Manual resolution required.

marco: Oh, flaky cache compactor race. The compactor can rewrite manifests to dedupe layer refs when two uploads overlap. If some mirrors got the old manifest and others the compacted one, deploy-bot will see a diff.

eva: Options: A) pin to manifest sha256:111aaa (first pushed) and promote; B) prefer compacted manifest 222bbb and promote; C) rebuild and push fresh image (delays window). Which is safer?

sre-bot: Risk summary: 111aaa -> references larger set of layers (some redundant). 222bbb -> compacted layer refs, smaller surface, but some mirrors still reference 111aaa blobs and could 404 until they sync. Both pin options require smoke. Rebuild costs ~50m.

fiona: We need fastest safe path. Can we run cross-mirror HEAD checks for top 3 blobs of both manifests, and then pick the manifest where blob HEADs are present on >=2 mirrors? If tie, pick original (111aaa).

marco: I'll script checks. Commands:
```
# list blobs referenced by manifest
skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:canary-20260324 | jq -r '.layers[].digest' | head -n 3
# HEAD test against mirrors
for m in registry mirror-eu mirror-us; do curl -I https://$m.redwood.ai/v2/redwood/inference/blobs/sha256:<blob> -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $m"; done
```

ci-cache: Running checks now. Manifest 111aaa top3 blobs: b1,b2,b3. Manifest 222bbb top3 blobs: b1,b2 (deduped), b4. HEAD results: registry: b1 200,b2 200,b3 200,b4 404. mirror-eu: b1 200,b2 200,b3 404,b4 200. mirror-us: b1 200,b2 200,b3 200,b4 404.

eva: Summary: b4 (only in compacted manifest) is present on mirror-eu but not on registry or mirror-us. b3 (only in original) present on registry+mirror-us but missing on mirror-eu. Neither manifest has universal coverage.

sre-bot: Tiebreaker policy per runbook: prefer manifest where majority of blobs are present across primary+1 mirror AND no mirror reports consistent 404s for commits. Here both manifests have one missing blob on one mirror. Recommend: pin to original manifest 111aaa (first push) because registry and 2/3 hosts have full blobs; then trigger immediate compactor + mirror sync to reconcile compacted manifest blobs, and add infra ticket to make compactor atomic.

fiona: Agreed. Plan: 1) pin promotion to sha256:111aaa and force unlock; 2) run smoke in eu-west (3 replicas) and run targeted HEADs for b1..b4 on mirrors during smoke; 3) kick compactor in reconciliation mode to push missing blobs where necessary; 4) open INFRA ticket to make compactor manifest rewrite atomic (INFRA-2301).

marco: Executing promote with digest pin now: `deploy-bot promote --tag canary-20260324 --digest sha256:111aaa --force-unlock --approved-by marco`.

deploy-bot: promotion resumed by @marco with pinned digest sha256:111aaa. promo-id=promo-1749456789-1.

ci-cache: Starting smoke: eu-west 3 replicas. Replica pulls: r1 ok, r2 ok, r3 transient 504 then ok. During smoke rechecked HEADs: registry b1..b3 200, mirror-eu b3 still 404 (compactor race), mirror-us all 200.

eva: Because mirror-eu had b3 404, I'll trigger compactor reconciliation to copy missing blob to mirror-eu. Kicking job now.

ci-cache: reconciliation job copied b3 -> mirror-eu OK at 10:16:50Z. Rechecked HEADs: mirror-eu b3 200 now.

sre-bot: Smoke verification passed: no 404s observed post-reconciliation. Promotion stable.

fiona: Unblocking change window. Created INFRA-2301: "compactor manifest rewrite atomicity + mirror sync checks" and added runbook step to run cross-mirror HEAD checks before auto-promotion.

deploy-bot: promotion completed; release window cleared.

fiona: Thanks everyone. Closing thread. :tada:
